data.body: Investigation complete (INTERMEDIATE). ROOT_CAUSE: dispatch.py _FROZEN_FIELDS includes 'severity' with no conditional carve-out, so when LLM emits a doc-supported but enum-invalid value ('suggestion'), schema correction maps it to 'minor' but the frozen-field guard rejects the correction and synthesises a fail-closed schema_error. Doc/runtime drift: REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md, REVIEW-SCHEMA.md, CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md, contracts/review-event-schema.md all reference 'suggestion' as a severity. Approved fix: add conditional carve-out for severity (mirror cited_lines/finding_id pattern at dispatch.py:1000-1036) — allow correction only when original is not in _VALID_SEVERITIES. testing_mode=RED, complexity=MODERATE.
